title: Latent Directions: A Simple Pathway to Bias Mitigation in Generative AI

bias_targets.methodology: Calculating the Statistical Parity Difference (SPD) of perceived genders in images generated for various profession prompts (e.g., doctor, firefighter, cleaner) using CLIP as a zero-shot classifier.
Measuring the Statistical Parity Difference (SPD) of perceived skin tones (e.g., dark vs. light skin) in generated images of people using CLIP attribute prediction.
Measuring the zero-shot classification scores and frequency of specific cultural representations (e.g., Indian weddings vs. Western weddings) in images generated from neutral prompts using CLIP.

Evaluating the presence of poverty-associated stereotyped objects (e.g., thatched roofs, mud huts) versus wealthy indicators in generated images for specific demographic prompts using vision-language models.
Evaluating the frequency of generated objects in out-of-distribution contexts (e.g., waterbirds in terrestrial environments) using the Waterbird benchmark.
